name: Flag pole
summary: Tall flag pole with a plain flag in any colour that ripples in the breeze; no national flags or emblems.

params.name: y
params.note: floor line: the base plinth stands on y

params.name: s
params.note: about 430 px wide and 1360 px tall at s = 1

params.name: anim
params.note: lights = the flag ripples in the breeze; pop = scales in

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror so the flag flies to the left
